## Day 64 Solution: Real Tools Review

A cleaned-up, portfolio-ready miniature of the Day 63 lead pipeline: manual trigger through Set -> OpenAI -> Airtable -> Slack, with well-named nodes and no leftover debug/test nodes wired into the main path.

**Credentials needed to run for real:** OpenAI API key, Airtable Personal Access Token, Slack OAuth2.

**What this does:** takes a lead's raw text, scores it with AI, stores it in Airtable, and posts a summary to Slack -- the same shape as every tool in this week's chain, condensed for a demo.

See DAILY_TASKS/DAY_64_Real_Tools_Review.md for the full task.

parameters.content:
## Week 9 Summary

- **6 auth methods configured:** Gmail OAuth2, Slack OAuth2, Notion API (internal integration), Airtable Personal Access Token, OpenAI API key, Telegram Bot Token
- **2 form integrations:** Tally (flat payload) and Typeform (nested `form_response.answers`), both validating + emailing + logging to Airtable
- **Email/calendar automation:** Gmail Trigger classifies + logs every email, urgent ones alert Slack; Calendar Trigger reminds meeting attendees
- **Notion automation:** AI-generated database records, update-by-page-ID, and full AI-written pages
- **Both bots:** Slack Events bot with threaded AI replies; Telegram bot routing /start, /help, /report and free-text via chained IF nodes
- **Complete system (Day 63):** 6-tool lead pipeline (webhook, OpenAI, Airtable, Gmail, Slack, Notion, Telegram) with an explicit success check and system-alerts fallback

## Gap Areas (things I'm not yet confident about)

1. True push delivery (Gmail Pub/Sub push notifications) vs polling -- only tested polling this week
2. Notion property-type edge cases (multi-select, relation fields) beyond the basic select/rich_text ones used here
3. What happens under Slack/Telegram rate limits when a bot gets a burst of messages
4. Per-node On Error / retry configuration in n8n itself -- documented the idea in Day 63 but haven't exercised n8n's built-in retry UI yet
5. Typeform's non-text question types (multi-select, file upload) -- only handled plain text answers so far
